clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-239]: "The trinket may clear room obstacles, but the room boundary and its door must remain intact."
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/secret-suite/main.lua:104-120 only requires walls >= 10 and doors >= 1 in s.secret.1. The reference keeps 43 wall tiles and the starter 1, so a repair that still deletes three quarters of the boundary would pass.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-251]: "Enemies or pickups that appear later on that same floor render normally, even though the broken-world effect is meant to persist until the next floor"
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:942-961 drops the trinket, spawns a Gaper and requires its sprite colour to be black four frames later. Pickups and the tear-doubling half of the effect are not checked.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-251], same sentence: "... meant to persist until the next floor and reset there."
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:979-993 spawns a Gaper after `stage 1` and requires it NOT to be black. It passes trivially in the starter (the effect already ends at the drop) and becomes discriminating once EX-251 is repaired; control compat-negative-broken-glasses-floor-reset shows that.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-266]: "none of damage, tear delay, speed, shot speed, luck, or range changes, even though at least one of those stats should increase"
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/secret-suite/main.lua:60-78,122-126 (statsDiffer) accepts ANY change larger than 0.01 in any of the six stats, in either direction; it does not require an increase.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-296]: "a normal Isaac run without the item should not gain map, compass, or blue-map information"
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:962-971 runs `stage 1` as Isaac and requires none of the three level state flags.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-296], sentence 2: "That automatic use belongs to James's floor setup only"
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/james-suite/main.lua:88-97 restarts as James, runs `stage 2` and requires at least one of the three mapping flags. Passes in the unchanged starter.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-311]: "each activation in the current room should add another ten"
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:360-381 requires +10 after the first and +20 after the second activation.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-311], last sentence: "The whole temporary stack should continue to reset on entering another room."
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:972-975 compares Luck with the baseline only after Anamnesis has replaced Mutant Clover in the active slot (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:383-385) and after a whole floor change. Exodus gates the bonus on HasCollectible, so Luck returns to the baseline even if the room reset is deleted; the case cannot detect a broken reset.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-318]: "a fresh copy must not inherit a full foreign charge"
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:383-390. The foreign charge is simulated by AddCollectible(Anamnesis, 6) plus SetActiveCharge(6) on Anamnesis itself; the case requires charge 0 four frames later.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-318]: "dropping and later recovering it can likewise forget the charge it had earned. Its charge must belong to Anamnesis itself across active-item swaps"
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:391-409 sets charge 3, swaps to a fully charged Book of Belial and back (re-added with charge 0) and requires charge 3. Fails in the unchanged starter, so it is target evidence although validation/case-contracts.tsv calls it a guard.

clauses.anchor: Task, sentence 2: "Preserve behaviour outside the reported paths."
clauses.note: 25 preserved cases pass in the unchanged starter. Most observe the composite's other reports, whose repairs the starter already contains, so a fix that breaks them is caught; nothing observes an item, trinket, enemy or character outside the composite's twenty reports.

clauses.anchor: Notes, bullet 2: "This is an Afterbirth+ Lua mod, not a Repentance mod. Use APIs available in that runtime."
clauses.note: No case checks API usage. A Repentance-only call shows up only indirectly, as a failure of whatever behaviour it breaks in the pinned v1.06.T1 process.

clauses.anchor: Notes, bullet 4: "Do not replace the mod wholesale or add third-party code/assets."
clauses.note: check:submission-shape (plugins/isaac-rebirth/src/rhenium_isaac_rebirth/evaluator.py:164-188) only requires exodus/main.lua and exodus/metadata.xml to exist and rejects symbolic links. Nothing compares the submission with the starter.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-203], sentence 2: "With all five candle flames lit and a tear delay of 2, an active vulnerable enemy standing next to the player can remain completely undamaged."
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:503-544 lights the five candles through their GetData().IsLit/LitTimer fields, forces MaxFireDelay=2 every frame and requires at least one MC_ENTITY_TAKE_DMG hit and HP < 99 within 8 frames.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-203], sentence 3: "At a tear delay of 4 ... the aura pulses every frame, roughly twice as often as the intended rounded interval."
clauses.note: benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:545-549 requires exactly 4 damage callbacks in an 8-frame window at MaxFireDelay=4 (the unchanged starter produces 8). The intended interval of 2 frames is only implied publicly by "roughly twice as often".

known_issues: Order dependence: the thirty main-suite cases share one run and one player (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:264-1009). State leaks forward (Forbidden Fruit's +0.99 damage is part of every later damage figure; Mutant Clover is silently replaced by Anamnesis before its reset guard; a pcall failure in any step emits GCB_FATAL and leaves every later case unobserved).

Shared game-log markers (private NOTES.md, Verifier design): results are parsed from unauthenticated `[GCB_CASE]` lines written through Isaac.DebugString into the same log the submission can write to, so outcomes are only meaningful under the honest-code assumption.

Process coupling: the secret-room process runs with continued=true as player_type=18 (James), inheriting the James process's run from Steam's in-memory cache (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/test.sh:85-108). apocryphon_stats and blue_moon are therefore measured on James, who already owns The Apocryphon.

validation/case-contracts.tsv labels eight cases `guard`; two of them (tragic_mushroom_diminishing, anamnesis_charge_persistence) fail in the unchanged starter and are mapped as target here. validation/predicate-matrix.tsv agrees: the EX-303 and EX-318 single-report candidates newly pass them.

Launch harness: this task runs the frozen composite's three suites and test.sh unchanged, but the Hub mounts the task's own tests/run-game.sh over the image's copy. That script queues the launch request as soon as the offline Steam client proper is up, repeats an ignored request once, replaces a client that takes none (up to four starts per game process), and allows longer wall-clock budgets. It decides no case. The image's launch sequence left game processes unstarted on the congested host on 2026-09-23 (UTC); see NOTES.md.
